_doc: Every workflow step that calls the GitHub API with the repository's GITHUB_TOKEN (1,000 REST requests an hour, shared by every workflow), as `workflow file: step name` -> why it may, and its calls per run where known.

scripts/ci/github_token_budget_lint.py warns (never fails) on a step that spends the token and is not here. Prefer git (ls-remote, fetch --filter=blob:none), the event payload or an App token over a new line.
"baseline 2026-11-04" marks a step that was already there when this file started; replace it with a reason when you touch the step.

steps.actions-artifact-prune.yml: Prune: polls (tests/test_ci_no_github_token_polling.py): hourly: paces artifact deletes 0.4 s apart (at most 150 a minute) and stops at 50 calls left
steps.app-ffi-release.yml: Pin the new release: re-pin hold (publish-app-ffi-repin.sh): one release-runs list, one jobs read per pending newer run, and the held PR's commit, check runs and status: about 3 to 8 calls per run, on a feat-cmux-next FFI push; a call refused for the rate limit is asked again only after its retry-after or reset (else 60 s doubling), 600 s in all, then the job fails
